categories.direct: Exact STS2 singleton/current-room and owner callbacks.
categories.ritsu_stable: RoomEntering/Entered/Exited events expose room and run state, but not every current UI owner.
categories.version_effect: Room hook signature churn may be absorbed for subscribed events; UI owner types remain Platform-known.

categories.direct: Platform reads STS2 logical state and projects Platform records.
categories.ritsu_stable: No Combat, Treasure, or Shop legal-action catalog.
categories.version_effect: None unless Ritsu adds domain catalogs, which would still not become Platform authority automatically.

categories.direct: Calls CardModel, PotionModel, Hook, phase, inventory, and room validators directly.
categories.ritsu_stable: No public facade over sampled native legality validators.
categories.version_effect: Platform remains coupled to validator signatures.

categories.direct: Native object references remain Host-local operands.
categories.ritsu_stable: Lifecycle events carry some native subjects but do not provide a general binding registry.
categories.ritsu_dev: ManagedActions bind Ritsu-created actions, not arbitrary vanilla/Human actions.
categories.runtime_cost: ManagedActions would add a second action family if misapplied.

categories.direct: Platform registers explicit Harmony targets and owns failure handling.
categories.ritsu_stable: IPatchMethod, PatchTarget, ModPatcher, required-patcher rollback and diagnostics.
categories.version_effect: Exact target type/member/signature remains in Platform patch declarations.
categories.runtime_cost: Ritsu patch inventory and startup lifecycle.

categories.direct: Reflection/AccessTools field or method resolution with local fail-closed handling.
categories.ritsu_stable: PrivateAccess resolves typed field refs/delegates and throws on missing members.
categories.version_effect: Private member names and types remain exact Platform-owned knowledge.
categories.runtime_cost: Ritsu dependency for a bounded helper.

categories.direct: Harmony plus local async/task seams when necessary.
categories.ritsu_stable: Patch helpers and LifecyclePatchTaskBridge cover Ritsu-owned hooks; general arbitrary task completion remains custom.
categories.version_effect: Can centralize repeated hook-task wrapping only when a suitable Ritsu lifecycle event exists.

categories.direct: Platform observes exact GameAction and domain callbacks.
categories.ritsu_stable: Typed card, potion, turn, room, reward, purchase and run lifecycle events.
categories.version_effect: Subscribers can avoid hook signature churn for covered events.

categories.direct: Exact GameAction instance events expose started, pause/resume, cancel, finished and execution order.
categories.ritsu_stable: Effect-level events do not carry the generic root GameAction or cancel/abort disposition.
categories.runtime_cost: Ritsu events are additive diagnostics, not replacement authority.

categories.direct: ActionExecutor.CurrentlyRunningAction supplies the exact parent root.
categories.ritsu_stable: PlayerChoiceContext-related effects exist, but no generic parent/continuation lineage API.

categories.direct: Connector calls exact STS2 callbacks/actions and relies on native multiplayer paths.
categories.ritsu_stable: Networking utilities exist; no general vanilla BoundAction submission facade.
categories.ritsu_dev: ManagedActions help custom Ritsu actions, not arbitrary vanilla callbacks.
categories.version_effect: Potential value for future Platform-created test actions only.
categories.runtime_cost: Must not create a duplicate executor.

categories.direct: Platform pins exact game identity and updates direct seams when APIs move.
categories.ritsu_stable: Cumulative STS2_AT_LEAST defines and internal compatibility shims across supported API targets.
categories.ritsu_dev: Same mechanism with unreleased fixes possible.
categories.version_effect: Covered Ritsu events/helpers can absorb churn; Platform semantic calls and private names cannot use internal shims.
categories.runtime_cost: Requires matching Ritsu package plus Platform exact admission.

categories.direct: Small Platform startup audit and patch failure reporting.
categories.ritsu_stable: Structured patch inventory, criticality, rollback, logs and framework lifecycle.
categories.version_effect: Improves diagnosis but does not prove compatibility.
categories.runtime_cost: Large framework/config surface for a capability Platform already has narrowly.

categories.direct: Platform exact identity and Modset admission only.
categories.ritsu_stable: Compatibility, diagnostics and update settings require an additional strict fingerprint.

categories.direct: Platform exact-game fixtures and deterministic contract tests.
categories.ritsu_stable: Diagnostics, console, state presets and patch test helpers are broad but many are privileged/debug-only.
categories.ritsu_dev: ManagedActions and debug tooling continue evolving.
categories.version_effect: Useful for investigation; cannot qualify semantic parity by itself.
categories.runtime_cost: Must remain outside gameplay authority and fair-player evidence.

categories.direct: Intersects Platform semantic actions with visible/reachable UI and owns binding/delivery.
categories.ritsu_stable: No Player Environment projection or stale/idempotent Receipt contract.
categories.runtime_cost: Must not create a second authority.

categories.direct: Correlates exact Human input with root GameAction lifecycle and causal boundaries.
categories.ritsu_stable: Effect events can enrich diagnostics but lack exact root/disposition/lineage.
categories.ritsu_dev: No sampled arbitrary Human-action correlation API.
categories.version_effect: Covered effect hooks may reduce auxiliary patches only.

categories.direct: Owns process/profile/headless/recovery outside the game process.
categories.version_effect: No replacement for external lifecycle or exact environment identity.
categories.runtime_cost: Additional loaded Mod in every Host environment.
